title: When were the new moon and the full moon?
description: A graph of moonrise and moonset times over a month is used to find the dates of the new moon and the full moon. The video links moonrise in the morning with the new moon and moonrise in the evening with the full moon, and notices how the times shift each day.
teaching_notes: One idea: the time of moonrise tells the phase of the moon, and the moon times shift later each day. Watch for students who expect the moon to follow the sun's fixed timings.

source: Figure it Out (more on mean and median, question 15)
video_script.why: The child has matched a peak on a line with its cause, and now matches a time of day on a line with a moon phase.
video_script.substitution: Link moonrise in the morning with the new moon and moonrise in the evening with the full moon, then find those dates on the graph.
video_script.anchor: the book's graph of the moonrise and moonset times over a month
video_script.payoff_line: moonrise is near sunrise for the new moon and near sunset for the full moon

final_answer.value: Dates are read from the graph where moonrise is near sunrise (new moon) and near sunset (full moon)
final_answer.spoken: the dates are read from the graph, where moonrise is near sunrise for the new moon and near sunset for the full moon

hold_back: near sunset for the full moon
never_show: the moon rises at the same time every day
maths_rules: new moon (amavasya): the moon rises and sets about with the sun; moonrise is in the morning and moonset in the evening
full moon (purnima): the moon rises about when the sun sets; moonrise is in the evening and moonset in the morning
find those dates on the graph; each moon time shifts about 50 minutes later every day
(ii) is open: for example, why the moon is not in the sky at the same time every day
slip: the moon does not keep the sun's fixed timings; its times shift each day
video_script.design: One idea: moonrise in the morning marks the new moon and moonrise in the evening marks the full moon. The graph stays on screen all video; no dates are invented.
open_questions: The graph values are not in the extracted book text, so the dates of the new moon and the full moon cannot be checked; the video gives the method, and the dates are left to the figure.
